title: East Nashville 2BR Cottage | King Bd + Fenced Yard
description:
Stay in this cozy cottage tucked away on a quiet dead-end street in East Nashville. Downtown and Broadway are just a short drive away, while East Nashville’s restaurants, coffee shops, bars and local favorites are easy to explore nearby.

With a king bed, private fenced backyard, fully stocked kitchen, washer and dryer, dedicated workspaces and free parking, you’ll have everything you need for a comfortable Nashville stay. Traveling with your pup? They’re welcome too!
